quote: These observations indicate that there is an important role for ROCK1 cleavage to limit immunogenic cell death which was not replicated by systemic administration of pharmacological ROCK inhibitors.
notes: 'Replicated' means pharmacological ROCK inhibition did not mimic the phenotype of the ROCK1nc mutation. The paper extends the authors' earlier work (Julian et al. 2021, @julian2021) with new endpoints; it does not set out to re-test that study's finding. Minor 'consistent with previous observations [1]' confirmations only.
